newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian woman guilty of raping another woman.
newsitem.headline: Australian woman guilty of raping another woman.

text.p: An Australian woman was found guilty on Tuesday of raping another woman in an intimate body search for drugs in the prison where both women were inmates.
Judge Andrew Wilson, in finding Susan Abraham guilty of raping a fellow inmate at a women's prison in June last year, said the victim's story was "too bizarre a story to tell if it was not true".

The prosecution said the victim, in her early 20s, agreed under pressure from other prisoners to get her boyfriend to smuggle drugs into the prison during a visit. But she could not contact her boyfriend and did not get the drugs.

The court heard she was grabbed at night in the prison toilet by three women who held her to the floor with her face covered while Abraham, 31, inserted her fingers into the victim's vagina to search for hidden drugs.
"It was not rape with sexual gratification driving it as is understood in the community," Wilson told the court.
"This was hostile and uncaring penetration rather than hostile gratification in a sexual sense," he said.
Sentencing was deferred. A woman co-accused with Abraham was found not guilty for lack of evidence.
